label: 易拉宝 · A 物种群像 + 四步棋盘路
prompt: Flat print-ready vertical roll-up banner designed as a clear infographic, full bleed, seen straight-on, only the 2D artwork. Very little text, every word big and readable from three meters, bold simple icons, generous spacing, large clear zones from top to bottom. The same retro constructivist propaganda-poster style as the reference images: heroic low angle, bold flat shapes, aged paper grain, fine halftone and worn ink texture, palette of warm cream, vermilion red, terracotta orange, mustard, deep teal, slate blue-grey and near-black green ink. Zone 1, the top 4.5 percent: a plain flat very dark teal-green (#0E2A27) band, completely empty, no text. Zone 2, the next 15 percent: the huge, heavy, chunky, slightly distressed hand-lettered title 我不是韭菜！ on one line in near-black green ink, filling the width, letterforms matching the second reference image; a small dark serif line I'M NOT A LEEK! under the right end of the title; cream and vermilion sunburst rays behind. Zone 3, right below: a vermilion ribbon banner across the width with big cream lettering 那你是哪种交易物种？ Zone 4, about 27 percent: the same neoclassical stock exchange as the first reference image (pediment carved EXCHANGE, columns, red vertical banners BUY and SELL, red flags, angular teal and grey skyscrapers), and in front of it, seen from below like monuments, the same six animal characters with exactly the same designs and clothes as the third reference image: the cheetah with a long red scarf, the elephant in a dark suit, the stern owl in a suit, the meerkat with crossed arms, the fox in a dark suit, the green chameleon in a suit with a curled tail; the cheetah is the tallest, in the center. At the right edge, one dark mysterious animal silhouette with a big glowing mustard question mark on it, a hidden seventh species. Below each of the six animals, a small cream name plate with its name in dark ink: 猎豹, 大象, 猫头鹰, 狐獴, 狐狸, 变色龙. Zone 5, about 23 percent: one thick winding board-game track of stone tiles snakes down the banner and connects four large round medallions in order, each with a big number and one bold flat icon, and a short big label beside it: medallion 1, icon of an old newspaper whose headline and date are hidden under black redaction bars with a small candlestick chart, label 闯金融史名场面; medallion 2, icon of a magnifying glass over evidence cards and a red rubber stamp, label 看证据，做决定; medallion 3, icon of a portrait card of a fox with three check marks, label 测出你的物种; medallion 4, icon of a signpost arrow and a ticket, label 领你的下一步. Next zone, about 12.5 percent: a big cream paper card. On its left, an empty, perfectly blank, pure white rounded square about 32 percent of the banner width, with a thin dark border; a QR code will be printed there later, so draw nothing at all inside it. On its right, the big hand-lettered words 扫码开玩 in near-black green with a thick vermilion arrow pointing left to the white square, and a vermilion starburst badge with cream text 3 分钟. Last zone, the bottom 12.5 percent: a plain flat very dark teal-green (#0E2A27) band, completely empty, no text. Keep every word and every face at least 5 percent away from the left and right edges. No logos, no real brands, no pandas, no real people, no QR code pattern anywhere. No other text besides 我不是韭菜！, I'M NOT A LEEK!, 那你是哪种交易物种？, EXCHANGE, BUY, SELL, 猎豹, 大象, 猫头鹰, 狐獴, 狐狸, 变色龙, 闯金融史名场面, 看证据，做决定, 测出你的物种, 领你的下一步, 扫码开玩, 3 分钟 and the numbers 1 to 4.
